```{r setup}
library("seq.sdid")
library(xtable)
#devtools::load_all()
set.seed(42)
```

```{r}
#CPS <- read.csv("data/CPS.csv")
data(CPS)
panel <- to_matrices(CPS, unit = 1, time = 2,
                     treatment = 'min_wage', outcome = 'log_wage',
                     never_treat = "2500")
panel <- prepare_matrices(panel, "unit")
```

```{r}
params <- estimate_dgp(
  panel$Y_avg, last_col(panel$W),
  4, TRUE, panel$never_treat
)
pi <- params$pi
pi[1] <- as.numeric(sort(pi)[2])
pi_scaled <- (pi - min(pi)) / (max(pi) - min(pi))
# Increase the treatment probability
pi_scaled  <- 0.35 + 0.65*pi_scaled
params$pi <- pi_scaled
panel_sim <- list(
  Y = NULL,
  W = NULL,
  X = subset(panel$X, select = -adopt_date),
  never_treat = "2500"
)
T <- ncol(panel$Y) - 1
```

```{r}
library(progress)

sim_setup <- list(rank = 4, N1 = 45, a1 = 20)
M <- 100
max_treat_periods <- T - sim_setup$a1 + 1
tau_array_sdid <- array(dim = c(max_treat_periods, M))
tau_array_did <- array(dim = c(max_treat_periods, M))
t_stat_sdid <- array(dim = c(max_treat_periods, M))
t_stat_did <- array(dim = c(max_treat_periods, M))
cohort_array <- array(dim = c(nrow(panel$Y), M))
pb <- progress_bar$new(total = M, format = "[:bar] :percent :eta :elapsed")
pb$tick(0)

for (m in 1:M) {
  sim <- simulate_dgp(params, sim_setup$N1, sim_setup$a1, TRUE)

  panel_b <- panel_sim
  panel_b$Y <- sim$Y; panel_b$W <- sim$W
  #s2 <- estimate_s2(Y, panel_b$W, panel_b$X$popwt)
  s2 <- params$sigma_2
  panel_avg <- prepare_matrices(panel_b, "unit", boot = FALSE)

  est <- sequential_estimator(panel_avg, "unit",
                              s2 = s2, "both")
  se <- vcov(est, panel_b, 100)
  max_lag <- length(est$tau_sdid)
  tau_array_sdid[1:max_lag, m] <- est$tau_sdid
  tau_array_did[1:max_lag, m] <- est$tau_did
  t_stat_sdid[1:max_lag, m] <- est$tau_sdid / se$se_sdid
  t_stat_did[1:max_lag, m] <- est$tau_did / se$se_did
  cohort_array[, m] <- sim$cohort

  pb$tick()
}
```

```{r fig.height=9, fig.width=9}
plot_t_stat(
  t_stat_array = t_stat_sdid,
  lags = c(0, 4, 7),
  type = "sdid",
  sim_name = "CPS",
  signal_share = 0,
  breaks = 50
)
```

```{r fig.height=9, fig.width=9}
plot_t_stat(
  t_stat_array = t_stat_did,
  lags = c(0, 4, 7),
  type = "did",
  sim_name = "CPS",
  signal_share = 0,
  breaks = 50
)
```

```{r}
create_tables(
  tau_array_sdid,
  tau_array_did,
  t_stat_sdid,
  t_stat_did,
  "CPS",
  0.0,
  FALSE
)
```

```{r fig.height=9, fig.width=9}
plot_cohorts(cohort_array, TRUE, 40, FALSE)
```
